title: Dispatch: Auditor campaign-rule context parity + A3 trace evidence (attempt 1)
description:
Implements eshyra-jhpt.4 (read its spec: parity + ADR 0020 amendment A3). Base: eshyra-jhpt @ 0c10403 (main after PR #524, which landed .1/.2/.3).

WORKTREE / BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.4.1 on branch eshyra-jhpt.4.1. npm ci already run.

CODE SURVEY (supervisor):
- orchestrator.ts runTurn: resolveCampaignPosition -> assembleContext (contextAssembler.ts) -> renderContextMessage(assembled) is the DM user message; the auditor call (deps.auditor.audit at ~line 675) receives playerInput, candidateResponse, providedToolNames, executedToolCalls, currentStateSnapshot: assembled.state, recentSceneEvidence — but NOT assembled.campaignRules. The accepted-turn trace (recordTurnTrace, ~line 829) stores retrievedContext: [renderContextMessage(assembled)] and rulesResolution.
- contextAssembler.ts ~line 1039-1075 renders the '## Campaign Rules' section inline inside renderContextMessage from ctx.campaignRules (type CampaignRulesContext in campaign/campaignContext.ts: position, ambiguitySourceUnavailable?, rules, unboundRulings, unrepresentableRules, ambiguities[{ambiguity, ruling, conflictingRulings}]).
- turnAuditor.ts: TurnAuditInput + buildAuditUserMessage (sections: Provided Tools, Explicit-Action-Only Tools, Executed Tool Calls, Canon-Tier Evidence, Recent Scene Evidence, Current State Snapshot, Player Input, Candidate DM Response); buildAuditSystemPrompt.
- memory/turnTrace.ts: TurnTraceRecord + jsonColumn codecs; table turn_trace; migrations are SQL files under packages/core/data/migrations/ (latest 0026_campaign_turn_positions.sql; ADR 0015 migration-first); orchestrator/turnTraceProjection.ts projects traces.

REQUIRED DESIGN (supervisor decisions):
1. ONE renderer. Extract the DM's campaign-rules section into an exported pure function `renderCampaignRulesSection(ctx: CampaignRulesContext): string | undefined` (in campaign/campaignContext.ts, next to assembleCampaignRulesContext; undefined when nothing to render, exactly mirroring today's condition). renderContextMessage uses it. Byte-identical output to today for the DM (prove with the existing contextAssembler tests).
2. Auditor input. Add `readonly campaignRules?: CampaignRulesContext` to TurnAuditInput. buildAuditUserMessage renders a '## Campaign Rules' section via the SAME renderCampaignRulesSection (or '(none)' when undefined/empty), placed before '## Player Input'. buildAuditSystemPrompt gains a short paragraph: active campaign rulings/house rules are binding on both DM and auditor; the auditor must judge the candidate against canonical pack semantics PLUS these rules; when it relies on one, cite its ruleIdentity in `reason`; it must never propose creating/modifying a rule. runTurn passes `campaignRules: assembled.campaignRules` — the very object the DM prompt rendered, no re-query.
3. A3 evidence. New migration 0027_turn_trace_campaign_rules_evidence.sql adding a nullable JSON column `campaign_rules_evidence` to turn_trace. TurnTraceRecord gains `campaignRulesEvidence?: CampaignRulesEvidence` (define the type in memory/turnTrace.ts): { position: string; rules: Array<{ruleIdentity, ruleKind, status, provenance, effectivePosition, governingRecordKeys}>; rulings: Array<{ruleIdentity, ambiguityId, selectedInterpretationId, effectivePosition}>; unresolvedAmbiguityIds: string[]; conflictingAmbiguityIds: string[]; ambiguitySourceUnavailable?: string }. Derive it with an exported pure function `campaignRulesEvidenceFrom(ctx: CampaignRulesContext)` and write it from runTurn in recordTurnTrace for the ACCEPTED turn (same assembled context). Decode it in readTurnTrace/list paths and surface it in turnTraceProjection.ts wherever the projection exposes trace fields (add, don't reshape). Older rows decode as undefined.
4. No second store, no auditor-side query, no retrieval policy (spec non-goals).

EVIDENCE (must FAIL against 0c10403 where applicable):
P1 Parity: a test that, for a campaign with a house rule, an ambiguity ruling, a superseded rule, a revoked rule, a future-scheduled rule and a disputed-turn rule at the immediately previous turn, assembles context at three positions (before supersession, after revocation, at the disputed turn) and asserts renderCampaignRulesSection(assembled.campaignRules) === the section extracted from buildAuditUserMessage({... campaignRules: assembled.campaignRules}) and === the section inside renderContextMessage(assembled); superseded/revoked/future rules absent; disputed rule present at the replayed turn; ordering deterministic.
P2 Wiring: runTurn with a recording fake auditor asserts the auditor received campaignRules deep-equal to the object whose rendering appears in the accepted trace's retrievedContext (no divergent builders), and the auditor system prompt mentions rule-identity citation.
P3 A3: after an accepted turn, readTurnTrace returns campaignRulesEvidence listing the rule identities/kinds/provenance/positions that were supplied, and the projection exposes it; a turn on a campaign with no rules records an evidence object with empty arrays (not undefined) so 'nothing supplied' is distinguishable from 'pre-A3 row'; a pre-migration row decodes as undefined.
P4 Migration: schema test/ledger updated per repo practice (see how 0026 was covered in tests).

VERIFICATION: npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing; report pass/skip counts and confirm worktree-local resolution. Do not touch campaignRuleStore.ts admission logic, the CLI, or discovery packet code.
